notes.title: The Thaumaturge | Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/cc3c28b6dd940aa198052e989117c5cb79ae0a43.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,
The Thaumaturge developed by Fool’s Theory published by 11 bit studios is an isometric, story-rich RPG with a unique take on turn-based combat, character development features, and investigation mechanics, facing you with morally ambiguous choices – set in 1905 Warsaw teeming with mysterious powers and strange ethereal beings called Salutors.

notes.title: New patch available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259819/374fa21886a7143f7144a79ca920bcddf2a1b349.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

A new patch is available on PCs and consoles. Changelog below:[list]
[*] Adjusted picture preview in the Behind the Scenes menu
[*] Button Icons adjusted in several scenes
[*] Turkish font changed to support all special characters
[*] Fixed visibility of toys in Peter's bedroom scene
[*] Adjusted position of Sam's hands in Peter's study scene
[*] Fixed red light in the Train Cabin scene, so it is properly synched now
[*] Several animations were adjusted
[*] Additional minor bug fixes
[/list]

Take care,
11 bit studios

notes.title: Save & Sound festival is live now. New Circles EP available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259819/c32f89e5f544e12ecf3a9eb3327e869e0aced0b2.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for [url=saveandsound.io]Save & Sound. [/url]


[h1][b]Circles EP: Frostpunk x South of the Circle[/b][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052810/Circles_EP_South_of_the_Circle_Edition/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30442987/4a27ac7c943f6d15caf8f8c160fb2d3dc745a426.jpg[/img][/url]

To join the celebration we're releasing a new mini album inspired by the music of Frostpunk and the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811040/South_of_the_Circle/]South of the Circle[/url]. If you've enjoyed Frostpunk and especially its outstanding soundtrack then you should definitely check out Circles EP. It's a fruitful result of a powerful collaboration of the Frostpunk OST composer and the creator of the South of the Circle OST. Two amazing artists covered each other's music  blending the original mood with the new sensibility. 

Get the full Circles EP containing all the tracks along with exclusive digital postcards here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052810/Circles_EP_South_of_the_Circle_Edition/

[b]South of the Circle is coming soon.[/b] Add the game to your wishlist and don't miss any future updates:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811040/South_of_the_Circle/

Take care,
11 bit studios
